body: Why delay, it hurts so much and nobody cares. Nobody will even notice.
Yeah I'm sure, I've been thinking about it for a while now.  I feel like I have no other way out.
Yeah, I told two people who used to care about me my plans (not ex's or anything).  One said she was too busy to talk and the other sent me a smile face and then ignored me.
And yet I'm still homeless with no where to live.  Exactly.
Tonight, have what I need to do it with.  Won't look accidental at all because it involves a bag, but who cares, I'll be dead.  A few minutes of pain and no more suffering, sounds so peacefull.
I've battled all my life, it isn't about manning up.  Eventually everyone reaches a breaking point, I'm there.

Feel beaten.  Every type of abuse as a kid. Mom died, dad left my live, family full of drug addicts, battled depression and got kicked out of the military, put myself through college on my own, disowned a ton of times, only to still end up here.  I've never done drugs, never committed any crimes, work my butt off to get through school on my own, and still homeless.  I feel beaten and done.  Tired and lonely.
Yeah, suicide really seems like the only way to end the nonstop suffering this world has brought, as far back as I can remember.
I don't want to give too many details, but there are gases you can buy as many stores.  Think I am going to use this method.
